intent: Teach each fact before sharing; personal opinion without treating opinions as automatically false; comparative rather than superlative; both projected benefits; note of unspecified hours with an explicitly new 09:00–17:00 example; already chosen river-wildlife scope; short paraphrase without banning all repeated words; water change with an explicitly new30→20litre example; labelling two shown features in an explicitly new flower schematic.
picturePurpose: Six original coded information graphics support personal-scope comparison, accurate notes, topic scope, paraphrase, numeric chart interpretation and two-part schematic labels. One before-sharing order and one exact projected-benefits selection complete the lesson. Numerical data and passages are explicitly new original examples.

transfer.stem: 换成通知、路线和计划，哪组三句完整保留了信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
发布通知前核实每个数字。在我看来，较短的路线更容易走。你的计划既能省水，又能节能。
词语提示：figure 数字；route 路线；energy 能源。

options.text: Check some figures before posting the notice. In my opinion, the shorter route is easier. Your plan would save both water and energy.
Check each figure before posting the notice. Everyone has proved that the shorter route is the easiest. Your plan would save both water and energy.
Check each figure before posting the notice. In my opinion, the shorter route is easier. Your plan would save both water and energy.
Check each figure before posting the notice. In my opinion, the shorter route is easier. Your plan would save only water, not energy.

answer.display: Check each figure before posting the notice. In my opinion, the shorter route is easier. Your plan would save both water and energy.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对each的范围、个人看法与比较级、both的两项内容。

steps.text: 发布前核实每个数字：each figure before posting。
steps.reason: some只保留部分，不能替换each；也不能把核实放到发布之后。

steps.text: 这是我的看法：In my opinion；路线是更容易走，不是最容易。
steps.reason: 不能换成所有人都已证明，也不能把easier换成easiest。

steps.text: 计划预计既省水又节能：would save both water and energy。
steps.reason: both两项都要保留，would没有说已经实际节省。

only water, not energy丢掉了both中的节能。
